source_description_html:
Introducing the Moto II: The future of motorbike navigation starts here. With the Moto II's intelligent turn-by-turn navigation, live riding statistics and speedometer, you'll always reach your destination and have a lot of fun doing it. The Moto II is waterproof, shockproof and has a battery life of 14 hours (in operation). It blends seamlessly into any motorbike cockpit without being distracting and is your perfect companion for any adventure.

Features:

  • High-quality display: With the improved display of the Moto II, you have an even more detailed visual experience - with a double screen area, high-resolution colour display, anti-reflective coating and water-repellent coating for optimum visibility in all conditions.
  • Endless power: With the Moto II's long battery life, months of standby time and an optional cradle for charging on the go, there's no need to worry about running out of power.
  • Convenient charging: The USB-C connection enables uncomplicated charging, compatible with your existing cables.
  • Intelligent battery management: Significantly extend the battery life of your smartphone when navigating with the Moto II so that you are always available.
  • Glove-friendly buttons: Operate the Moto II interface effortlessly with glove-friendly buttons that are accessible from any mounting position.
  • Improved navigation: Clear, concise turn-by-turn directions, speed and estimated time of arrival, and a simple arrow display for quick decisions while riding.
  • Driving statistics at a glance: Track speed, distance and time directly on Moto II and keep up to date in real time.
  • Multilingual support: Moto II supports eight languages, making it the perfect companion for riders worldwide.
  • Explore with compass mode: Compass mode lets you go off the beaten track by showing you only the direction of your destination - for a real adventure.
  • Safety First (depending on location): You can increase your driving safety with speed limit warnings.
  • Comprehensive tracking: Track every ride with the Beeline app, share routes or discover new routes with easy GPX import/export.
  • Optimised routing: Whether you're looking for thrills or comfort, Moto II's routing options ensure that every ride is an unforgettable journey.

Smartphone requirements:

  • iPhone: iOS 15 and higher
  • Android: Google Play with 8.0 Oreo and higher
  • Bluetooth 4.0 compatibility required

Screen:

  • Technology: Ultra-bright IPS TFT display with anti-glare and hydrophobic coating
  • Size: 36.8mm (1.45") screen diagonal, 10cm total area
  • Resolution: 412x412 (402ppi)

Sensors:

  • Accelerometer
  • gyroscope
  • magnetometer

Battery:

  • Type: Rechargeable Lithium-Polymer
  • Capacity: 600mAh
  • Battery life in use: 14 hours
  • Charging: USB-C with pogo pin interface

Water and particle resistance:

  • IP67 rated

Size and weight:

  • Dimensions: 53mm diameter, 20.5mm depth
  • Weight: 60g

Please note: Beeline Moto II requires a smartphone with Bluetooth connection to function.

Content:

  • 1x Beeline Moto II Metal Navigation System
  • 1x USB-C charging cable
  • 1x universal holder with rubber bands
  • 1x quick start guide
